title: Features
description: Everything you need for the perfect dice rolling experience

features.title: 2D Dice Simulation
features.description: Roll realistic 2D dice with smooth animations that bring your rolls to life.

features.title: Built-in Dice Presets
features.description: Includes standard 6-sided dice and popular D&D dice (D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20).

features.title: Custom Dice Creation
features.description: Create your own dice with fully customizable faces to match your unique style.

features.title: Editable Dice Faces
features.description: Each face can be customized using SF Symbols, Images, or Text for endless possibilities.

features.title: Dice Sets
features.description: Group dice into custom DiceSets and easily save and load them later for quick access.

features.title: Siri Integration
features.description: Roll a standard 6-sided die or D&D dice using Siri voice commands for hands-free rolling.

features.title: Home Screen Widgets
features.description: Roll dice directly from widgets with multiple sizes. Dice count adapts to widget size for optimal layout.

features.title: Persistent Storage
features.description: All custom dice and DiceSets are saved and available across app launches.
